newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela CANTV issue local orders surpass target.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela CANTV issue local orders surpass target.

text.p: Local orders for shares in Venezuelan telephone company CANTV totaled 147.096 billion bolivars ($313 million) at the close of the share offer, easily surpassing the official target of $200 million, according to official figures obtained by Reuters.
Of the 147.096 billion bolivar worth of orders placed, 102.909 billion ($219 million) were by small investors and 44.116 billion ($94 million) by institutional investors.
Some 75.489 billion bolivars ($161 million) of the small investors' orders were via special financing and the remaining 27.490 billion bolivars ($58 million) in cash.

The Venezuelan government has set aside 50 million shares for the local market in the 289 million global share offering, although the Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) is holding back a further 75 million in case of excess demand.
Final pricing of the issue is due to take place later on Thursday. The early reference range put the issue at between $3.07 and $3.50, although the final price may be higher.
